titulo: Walking ahead, then slowing down to match you
caption:
Walking ahead, then slowing down to match you

I was three steps ahead. You were not. So I came back one step and we got the same speed.

Nobody asked me to. That is the whole behavior.

Send it to the friend who always walks a little behind you, or a little ahead.

#Cella #relatable #friendship

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.

descripcion:
Three steps ahead. One step back. Same speed.

Slowing down for someone without being asked is a small, exact way to say "I am with you".

#Cella #relatable #friendship

NAOS · Closer to yourself. by NMR

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink hallway with a white door and a wooden plank floor that fills the lower third. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks briskly to the right while a royal blue figure with sleepy eyes lags three steps behind. The camera follows along the floor. The ink-black figure stops, goes wide-eyed, steps back toward the blue one and drops low with the camera to the feet. Then the two walk side by side at the same slow speed, the camera pulling back, and both smile. The text, which appears after the first second: me, three steps ahead. Now one step. Same speed.
